Coram : R.K. AGRAWAL*, ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE
Income Tax Act, 1961 - s.35D and ss.(l), 143(JB), 143(2) - Whether "premium" collected on subscribed share capital of a company is "capital employed in the business of the Company" C within the meaning of s.35D for claiming deduction of the said · amount u/s.35D - Held: issued share capital is not and cannot be said to be the part of "capital employed in the business of the Company" for the purpose of s.35D(3)(b) - If the intention of the Legislature were to treat the amount of "premium" collecte:l by D Company from its shareholders
Decision Date : 28-03-2017 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 2162/2007 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
